name: PETRONAS Chemicals Group Berhad
overview: 2026年资料中，公司未公布任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约公告；已披露的公告主要为季度业绩、年度审计账目、股东大会及股息除权安排。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收为79.03亿MYR，同比增长22.8%，净利润为4.14亿MYR。
overview_en: In the 2026 materials, the company did not announce any expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract for its business segments; the announcements disclosed were mainly quarterly results, annual audited accounts, general meetings, and dividend book closure arrangements. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 7.903 billion, up 22.8% year-on-year, with net profit of MYR 414 million.
